scientific_integrity: Claims rest on explicit mathematical proof, separately verified by finite direct graph enumeration and polynomial arithmetic. Computational evidence is not treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to simple labelled prisms and independent identically surviving sensors. The pair-distance result is prior known; the 2024 primary text was only partially accessible. No independent mathematical audit or publication-priority certification.
title: Exact power-domination and fragile-sensor census of circular ladders
